source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: The hole order is a guess. The 18 greens are the ones already on the map, but no tee boxes can be seen in the photo, so each tee was placed by hand in open ground at about the card's length, and holes were numbered by matching lengths and pars, not from a scorecard map.
